title: spec: user-facing refusal and advisory text is in the request locale (userMessage locale rule, advisory user text field), per ruling C on #32440
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Part of #32654 (tracking). Layer 1 of 3: the contract. Filed by triage from #32654's scope. ⛔ Not a claim.

Ruling (maintainer, verbatim, quoted on #32654): 「32440 选C，32043 一起按C处理」 (option C of 6819513436: the server returns localized advisory text in the request's language, rule id unchanged).

## Do

1. In `packages/spec`: state that `ApiErrorSchema.userMessage` (`src/api/contract.zod.ts`) and `EnhancedApiErrorSchema.userMessage` (`src/api/errors.zod.ts`) are in the request's locale, with the fallback rule (workspace default, then `en`).
2. Give advisory findings a user-facing text field beside the stable rule id (or extend an existing one), and have `packages/lint`'s findings (for example `validate-security-posture.ts`) carry it. Whether the catalog is spec-shipped or per producer is this lane's call within the ruling.
3. Declare it as a protocol addition; the server and console layers read it.

## Order

Layer 2 (server producers) and layer 3 (console) are `Blocked-by:` this card.
